_about: Water (1) + cyclohexane (2): mutual solubilities at 295 K and 100 kPa, the binary reference point of Danon et al. (2018). Rows: temperature in K, mole fraction of cyclohexane in the water-rich liquid, mole fraction of water in the cyclohexane-rich liquid.

source.citation: R. Danon, M. C. Kroon, F. Banat, Mutual Solubilities of Cyclohexane and Water in Aqueous Methyldiethanolamine/Cyclohexane Liquid-Liquid Equilibria, J. Chem. Eng. Data 63 (2018) 1123-1131
source.access: Journal article is subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 3 (mole fraction of cyclohexane in liquid mixture 1, the water-rich liquid) and 4 (mole fraction of water in liquid mixture 2, the cyclohexane-rich liquid), T = 295 K, P = 100 kPa. The table number in the article was not checked (article not open).

notes: Liquid I is the water-rich liquid, liquid II the cyclohexane-rich liquid; x_1 is the mole fraction of water, x_2 of cyclohexane. Expanded uncertainties in the record: 6.7e-06 (cyclohexane in water) and 6.6e-05 (water in cyclohexane). Values as stored in the ThermoML record (XML file), extracted with validation/python/thermoml_read.py; nothing converted or rounded. To be checked by a person against the record before use (AGENTS.md rule 4).
